name: Numin Pay (crypto payments and store credit #USDC #SOL)
author: Numin Labs

sections.installation: Fast and easy to install. Visit the dashboard to create your API key and start using the service.
sections.description:
Accept crypto payments on your e-commerce store

Payments

Provide more ways for your customers to pay.

Accept payments in USDC stablecoin and the biggest tokens in the Solana ecosystem.

Leverage Solana’s high-speed blockchain network to streamline your checkout and unlock merchant fees as low as .5%.

Tap into the massive user base of popular wallets such as Phantom Wallet, Coinbase Wallet, and Solflare.

Store Credit

Launch your very own crypto token which can be redeemed for store credit during checkout.

Drive additional revenue through token sales and raise awareness of your brand.

Mint new tokens and track your sales through a convenient online dashboard.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API service that is needed to intialize the payment gateway and verify payments.

The API sends the user’s order details every time they choose the payment option at checkout.

This service is provided by Numin Labs : Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Documentation
